- **Sclerotinia Timber Rot**: Also shows white cottony mycelium on stems, but typically at higher stem positions with black sclerotia inside hollowed stems
- The infection location (at/near soil level) and the white fluffy mycelium pattern strongly point to **Southern Blight**
